node_types.label: Person
node_types.description: An individual employee of Meridian Harbor, including team leads. Use the person's full name; people who share a first name (e.g. Priya Shah and Priya Nair) are different people.

properties.name: name
properties.description: Full name of the person, e.g. 'Priya Shah'.

properties.name: title
properties.description: Job title or role, e.g. 'procurement manager', 'Security Assurance reviewer', 'customer success manager'.

node_types.label: Team
node_types.description: A named team, e.g. Payments Engineering, Data Platform, Customer Operations or Harbor Operations. Not every team is an engineering group.

properties.name: name
properties.description: Name of the team, e.g. 'Payments Engineering'.

properties.name: function
properties.description: What the team does, e.g. 'engineering' or 'office facilities'.

node_types.label: Department
node_types.description: An organizational department that people or teams belong to, e.g. Commercial Operations or Security Assurance.

properties.name: name
properties.description: Name of the department, e.g. 'Commercial Operations'.

node_types.label: Responsibility
node_types.description: A kind of work or decision routed to a specific person, e.g. procurement negotiations, security acceptance, customer communications.

properties.name: name
properties.description: Short name of the responsibility, e.g. 'security acceptance'.

relationship_types.label: LEADS
relationship_types.description: The person is the lead of the team and is accountable for its work.

relationship_types.label: MEMBER_OF
relationship_types.description: The person belongs to the team or department.

relationship_types.label: REPORTS_TO
relationship_types.description: The person reports to another person in the management chain.

relationship_types.label: PART_OF
relationship_types.description: The team sits within the department.

relationship_types.label: HANDLES
relationship_types.description: The person, or the team, is the one this kind of work or decision goes to.
